dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Distinct, sharp pale edges along the margins of the folded primary and secondary feathers against the dark feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Clear boundary transition where the uniform dark plumage of the crown and nape meets the scaled texture of the upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform scalloped effect across the entire dorsal surface created by high-contrast pale fringes on dark feathers.
